title: <agent>/findings/<seat>-<YYYYMMDD>.json -- what one execution seat established, handed to the librarian
description: An execution seat's findings, on their way to the store. Added 2026-09-24, when the person asked that everything the day's sessions established be saved properly, and the only route from an execution seat to the librarian was a result card: that needs a plan, and most of the day's findings came from preparatory runs, which produce none (plan.md 11-21 condition 4). The librarian may enter a device's report of itself citing a preparatory run's log (20a688b), but nothing carried the list of what to enter. A message would carry it and leave no trace on disk, which is exactly what file cards exist to prevent. So this is the file. It is not a KB entry and grades nothing: the librarian reads it, checks each source, and enters what passes. Every item says what kind of fact it is, because the kinds travel differently. A value of a registered observable is listed so that it is not lost, and it is marked not for the store: it waits for the plan that cites its run.

fact.description: the fact, in words, as it would be entered

kind.description: self_report: what a device said about itself, read back in a run. document_fact: read from a named document. person_statement: said by the person, and recorded somewhere this names. prior_project_ruling: an item from the prior project, ruled under 10.2.1. observable_value: a value of an observable registered in contracts/observables.json, which a preparatory run may not carry into the store. unmeasured: something a session looked for and could not establish, or that was never seen -- bit depth when no frame saturated, a reply code that never came. It is a finding because it tells the next session not to look for it as though it were known, and the store may hold it as a named gap. Its source is where the absence was established: the run event, the document, or the record searched. Added 2026-09-24, after microscope-20260924-4 found the cards asked for unmeasured items and this shape gave them no kind

how.description: how it was established, in words

for_store.description: whether the seat proposes it for entry. Always false for an observable_value

event_index.description: the index of the event in the run log's events[] that carries the reading

recorded_at.description: where the person's statement is recorded: a commit, a file and field, or a run log event. A statement recorded nowhere is not a finding
